name: Granules India Limited
industry: Vertically integrated API / PFI / Finished-Dosage generics (US-generics-focused)

moat_sources.name: cost_advantage
moat_sources.evidence_note: Vertically integrated API->PFI->FD chain; EBITDA margin recovered from an ~18% FY24 trough (post-Gagillapur remediation cost drag) to 22.1% in FY26 as Finished-Dosage mix rose to ~77% of revenue (from 65%) -- a real, evidenced margin-recovery trend, not yet a proven durable premium versus peers given the industry's structural pricing deflation.

moat_sources.name: pricing_power
moat_sources.evidence_note: Company management (Forbes India interview) explicitly cites increased competition and US government drug-price-lowering measures as active pricing-pressure sources; ~77% of FY25 revenue is North-America-concentrated with large contract buyers able to negotiate volume/price.

moat_sources.name: switching_costs
moat_sources.evidence_note: Commodity/branded-generics manufacturing for 300+ customers in 80+ countries -- some ANDA/DMF qualification friction, but no evidence of durable customer lock-in; large buyers can and do resource generic API/FD supply on price.

moat_sources.name: intangible_assets
moat_sources.evidence_note: Early-stage move up the complexity curve (complex generics, emerging Peptide/CDMO segment per FY26 annual report) -- a real but nascent signal with no quantified revenue/margin contribution found yet, so not rated as an established moat source.

moat_sources.name: efficient_scale
moat_sources.evidence_note: Among the larger global manufacturers of select high-volume generic molecules (e.g. metformin, paracetamol family); real scale, but has not translated into standout returns (ROCE mid-teens, not exceptional) or insulation from customer-driven pricing pressure.

industry_context.phase_evidence: US generics is a mature, structurally pricing-deflationary industry -- consolidated buyer power and government price-lowering measures are compressing realizations sector-wide (management-confirmed for this name). Granules' own Finished-Dosage/complex-generics mix shift and margin recovery are real but appear company-specific execution, not evidence of an industry-wide inflection; no documented 3-year revenue-share gain vs. the sector was found.

bridge_assumptions.margin_delta_mechanism_note: Continued FD/complex-generics mix shift (FD ~77% of FY26 revenue vs 65% prior year) plus early complex-generics/Peptide-CDMO ramp, evidenced by the realized EBITDA margin improving from an ~18% FY24 trough to 22.1% in FY26.

variant_perception.market_belief: Priced as a steadily-recovering, complex-generics-mix-shift pharma story after the FY24-25 USFDA-remediation trough
variant_perception.whats_wrong_with_belief: No credible case found that this belief is wrong: the stock already trades near/at the rich sector multiple (trailing PE roughly in line with Nifty Pharma's elevated ~40x), and the Feb-2025 USFDA warning letter (not merely a Form 483) on the Gagillapur facility is a live, unresolved compliance overhang -- a real risk the market is arguably pricing reasonably, not obviously over- or under-reacting to.
variant_perception.gap_closing_event: Next USFDA re-inspection/warning-letter-closure outcome at Gagillapur (dated, observable, but outcome and timing genuinely unknown)

notes: DATA PROVENANCE: live aggregator sites (Screener, Moneycontrol, Tijori) were unreachable from this environment; sourcing is a mix of: (1) Tier 3 REAL anchors via WebSearch of news-aggregator reports of official results -- revenue & PAT for all 5 FYs (FY22-FY26), FY26 EBITDA (Rs1,185.1Cr, 22.1% margin), promoter holding (31.08% as of 11-Sep-2026, down from 38.82%, after a further large open-market sale), Nifty Pharma sector PE (40.55, Sep-2026), 10Y G-Sec yield (7.05%, 16-Sep-2026), price/market cap (16-Sep-2026); (2) Tier 4 management commentary on US generic pricing pressure (Forbes India interview) and complex-generics strategy; (3) Tier 3/direct FDA.gov confirmation of a warning letter dated 26-Feb-2025 to the Gagillapur facility (contamination-control and data-integrity findings, OAI classification since Dec-2024 -- NOT resolved, materially more serious than a bare Form 483 or Divi's Labs' 2018 import-alert case in this same repo's sample data); (4) Tier 5 RECONSTRUCTED balance-sheet detail (depreciation, interest, capex, NFA, CWIP, NWC, debt, cash, net worth, dividend, OCF, tax rate) solved to be internally consistent with the real revenue/PAT anchors and to approximately reproduce the sourced D/E (~0.3x), ROE (~14.1%) and ROCE (16.6% FY25 / ~15.7% current) ratios -- NOT independently itemized from an audited balance sheet, since none was reachable. FY22 revenue/PAT is the single weakest-sourced anchor (one aggregate search summary only). Shares outstanding (24.78Cr) and diluted shares (27.27Cr, post a ~10% warrant-conversion equity raise used partly to reduce leverage) come from two sources that were not fully reconcilable to the same date -- flagged rather than silently resolved. No credible variant-perception case was found (N7 left unanswered, capping this at WATCH per the framework regardless of the composite score): the stock is not priced as an unfairly-punished asset the way Divi's was in the 2018 backtest dossier in this repo -- it trades near the rich sector multiple with a live, unresolved USFDA warning letter and a recent large promoter open-market sale, neither of which supports manufacturing a bull thesis, and neither of which is a smoking-gun fraud/kill-gate finding either.
